bio: Named in honour of renowned French chef Georges Auguste Escoffier, who joined the hotel in 1890, this intimate room inside The Savoy features rich, golden hues, art deco touches and just 10 well-spaced tables. The surprise tasting menu is in part inspired by Escoffier’s classics but prepared using modern techniques, resulting in dishes with elegance and poise, underpinned by high-quality ingredients such as Cornish John Dory. A shorter, four-course version of the menu is available on Friday and Saturday lunchtimes....
